channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Texas executes Jamaal Howard after concerns over lethal injection drug
item.description: Texas executed Jamaal Howard on Tuesday, marking the first execution in the state since concerns arose over the lethal injection drug used in a prior failed execution in Tennessee. The execution proceeded despite these concerns. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Police investigate possible serial killer in Lansing, Michigan
item.description: Lansing police are investigating the possibility of a serial killer after five men suffered fatal injuries along a popular city trail. Police Chief John O'Malley has warned residents about the potential threat. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.
